# Story 19.2: Consolidate into one explicit environment classifier and remove placeholder fallbacks

Status: ready-for-dev

## Story

As a developer,
I want `isDevEnvironment` and `isDevOrTest` merged into one explicit classifier with the broken-config placeholder fallbacks removed,
So that there is a single source of truth for environment classification and no path produces a broken config (P1 item #2 from Aspect 9 of the critical review).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Story 19.1's red-phase tests pass: `apps/server/src/utils/aws-config.ts` exposes exactly ONE environment classifier, all call sites use it, and it returns the correct environment for each representative `NODE_ENV`.
2. The two former classifiers (`isDevEnvironment()` at lines ~146–150 and `isDevOrTest()` at lines ~230–234) are merged into a single explicit classifier; no call site references the removed names.
3. No placeholder fallback (e.g., `process.env.DATABASE_URL` at lines ~216–219) yields a broken config — missing env vars either throw or use a clearly-named default, not an empty string that silently produces an unusable configuration.
4. Behavior for valid environments is preserved: dev/test/production/local all resolve to the same effective configuration as before consolidation.
5. The previously-skipped tests from Story 19.1 are unskipped (`.skip()` removed) and pass under `nx test server`; the full server suite is green with no pre-existing test modified, weakened, or removed.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [ ] Task 1 (AC: #1–#4): Remove skip markers and confirm red.
  - [ ] 1.1 In the specs added by Story 19.1, remove every `it.skip` marker and run `nx test server`, confirming the new assertions FAIL against current code (red).
- [ ] Task 2 (AC: #2): Merge the two classifiers into one.
  - [ ] 2.1 In `apps/server/src/utils/aws-config.ts`, merge `isDevEnvironment()` (line ~146) and `isDevOrTest()` (line ~230) into a single explicit classifier method that returns the correct environment for each `NODE_ENV` value.
  - [ ] 2.2 Update all call sites (lines ~45, ~107, and any others) to use the new single classifier; remove the old method definitions.
- [ ] Task 3 (AC: #3): Remove broken-config placeholder fallbacks.
  - [ ] 3.1 In `apps/server/src/utils/aws-config.ts`, replace the `process.env.DATABASE_URL` fallback at lines ~216–219 with either a clear error throw or a well-named default that does not silently produce an empty/broken config.
- [ ] Task 4 (AC: #4): Verify behavior preservation for valid environments.
  - [ ] 4.1 Confirm dev/test/production/local all resolve to the same effective configuration as before consolidation; no valid-environment path regresses.
- [ ] Task 5 (AC: #5): Confirm green suite.
  - [ ] 5.1 Run `nx test server` and confirm fully green with Story 19.1's tests now passing (unskipped).

## Dev Notes

- **Why:** `apps/server/src/utils/aws-config.ts` currently exposes two divergent classifiers — `isDevEnvironment()` (lines ~146–150) and `isDevOrTest()` (lines ~230–234) — plus a placeholder fallback (`process.env.DATABASE_URL`, lines ~216–219) that can produce broken configs. Consolidating into one explicit classifier removes the divergence and reduces a security footgun (P1 item #2 from Aspect 9).
- **First task is always unskip → confirm red → implement.** The red-phase tests from Story 19.1 define the target; do not edit their assertions to make them pass, only the production code.
- **Behavioral preservation:** for valid environments (dev/test/production/local), the effective config must be identical before and after consolidation. Only broken-config paths change behavior (they now throw or use a named default instead of silently producing an empty string).
- Vitest is the workspace test framework; server tests run via `nx test server`.

### Project Structure Notes

- Modify: `apps/server/src/utils/aws-config.ts` (merge classifiers, remove placeholder fallbacks, update call sites).
- Modify: Story 19.1's spec (remove `.skip()` markers only — no assertion changes).
